title: Single-Threaded Task Multiplexing Stall
pattern: Executing a massive, CPU-intensive computation loop within an asynchronous future without yielding back to the executor.
why_bad: Asynchronous tasks are cooperative. They only yield control to the executor at `.await` boundaries. A long-running CPU-bound loop without `.await` points monopolizes the executor thread, stalling all other tasks on that thread.
detection: Large mathematical loops or complex procedural blocks in an `async fn` that lack `.await` or yield points.
counterexample: Spawning the heavy computation on a dedicated blocking thread pool using `spawn_blocking`.
